sign: Wild Spirlings here are strong. Travel with care.

lines: Bobbing in the reeds: a Power Brew, still sealed!
Only reeds and a curious frog.
The water runs uphill toward the hollow since the storm.
Spirlings hide in the reeds. Wade through and one may come out.
My lamp drowned in the flood. A Wickit's light would see me home. Know one?
I still see that little light when I close my eyes. Thank you.
Neve: Good fight. Here, a diver's Grapple Line. Hook it on a far post and pull yourself over the water.
Neve: Try the reed islet by the Brindlewick pier. Divers stash things there.
Neve: The Warden down there, Maelis, used to sing to the tide. Now she just stares at it.

neve_intro: Neve: Heading for the hollow? Let's see if you're ready!
kestra_tag: Kestra: These two are draining the pools for Rift-salt. The Spirlings here have nowhere left to go.
kestra_tag_intro: Kestra: You're just in time. I can't hold them off alone.
Kestra: We don't agree about the Rifts, I know. But this is wrong either way.
Hauler Tobin: Two against two, then. Wren, ours step up!
kestra_tag_defeat: Hauler Tobin: Fine! We'll find salt somewhere else.
Kestra: Not bad, partner. Maybe we want the same thing after all.
Kestra: I'll keep mapping the marsh. See you out there.

lines: Hauler Wren: Rift-salt fetches a fine price in Corvane. Move along.
Hauler Wren: We're packing up, all right?

aud: Aud: A snare waits for the next Spirling that steps in. Swap with care.
aud_intro: Aud: I mend nets, and I lay them too. Mind your step!
aud_defeat: Aud: Torn right through. Next time I'll knot them tighter.
